IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost]') ) EXEC('CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost]() RETURNS INT AS BEGIN RETURN 0 END') else BEGIN
EXEC('alter FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime,@CompanyID INT, @PeriodID INT) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((
case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <> 0 then
((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / (case when std.transactionquantity > 0 then std.transactionquantity else 1 end)
else std.transactioncost end
))
TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = ''Positive'' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND isnull(INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports ,0) = 0 WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 AND sth.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
); ')
